mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals accelerating labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE declines >0.3pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.5% and unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.3 percentage points in one month creates a policy-labor market synergy that accelerates corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% AND UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances meeting both conditions, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (RSAFS > $350 billion), a monthly increase in residential construction (HOUST) above 0.5% signals robust household spending that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where RSAFS > 350 billion and HOUST rises >0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production (INDPRO) level above 100 (index 2017=100) indicates expanding manufacturing capacity that supports corporate profit growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in unemployment rate below 9.0% signals strengthening labor market conditions that increase disposable income and consumer spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 9.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained residential sales (RSAFS) level above $350 billion indicates strong household spending that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependency.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 350 billion, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains above -0.03 over any 3-year window.
